_about: Access keys are one word from this list plus four digits, e.g. VELVET 4827. Digits are drawn from 2 to 9 only, so 0 and 1 never get confused with O and I. 40 words x 8^4 digit combinations = 163,840 possible keys.
input_rules: Accept any case: velvet 4827, Velvet4827 and VELVET 4827 all match.
Ignore spaces, dashes and dots when comparing.
Store only a hash of the normalized key (uppercase, no spaces). Show the plain key to the inviter at creation and in the message, never again after that.
A resend or Reset access generates a new key and invalidates the old one.
